oncall-bot: @jess you're on primary, please ack and coordinate. :phone:
jess: ack. seeing 5xxs and latency spike to ~1.2s p95. Starting triage. Is there a correlated deploy?
omar: no deploys in the window per deploy-bot. infra autoscale kicked twice around the start.
lina: customers reporting degraded streaming responses. Sam from support is getting multiple tickets. @sam can you confirm customer impact?
sam: a few paying customers (enterprise) see truncated streams and occasional 502s. No data loss reports but UX broken. Will escalate in support threads.

jess: (ignore the spam lines above, sorry — weird paste) continuing: first, mitigation checklist: 1) route-by-latency fallback to smaller model, 2) scale up dedicated pool, 3) collect traces/logs. I'm running query to get request ids for errors.
omar: sharing quick logs:
```
ERROR 2024-06-07T18:00:12Z request_id=req_7f3b path=/v1/generate status=502 backend_err="kvcache-miss"
ERROR 2024-06-07T18:01:03Z request_id=req_82a1 path=/v1/generate status=503 backend_err="oom"
```

jess: thanks. hypothesis 1: backend model pod OOMs under burst; hypothesis 2: routing change sent traffic to quantized variant causing instability; hypothesis 3: logging sampling or aggregator misconfig hides useful traces. Let's track in-thread.
lina: I ran top query on infra: memory on the model pool shot up, a few pods restarted. Pod logs show sudden large batches at ~17:59.
omar: we saw anomalous batching windows — some clients sent long-context requests. We have per-customer token length metrics. @ada can you map token distribution for the timeframe?

ada: ada here (prod-analytics). sending chart: median input tokens jumped from ~300 to ~4500 between 17:58-18:02 for a few API keys (masked). Looking up API keys now.
jess: that supports hypothesis 1. mitigation step: enable stricter request length limit at the edge and queue large jobs to lower-priority pool. Can someone flip the edge limit?
lina: I can add a temporary request size guard at the gateway. Pushing config in 30s.
omar: putting model-pool in graceful drain for new long requests, and adding a quick autoscale to +4 pods.

--- 10m later ---

lina: gateway rule applied: max_input_tokens=2000 for public API keys. We still see errors but reduced.
sam: support sees fewer new tickets. existing truncated streams still happening for earlier requests.
jess: good. next: RCA coordination — we need full traces for a sample of failing request_ids. I'm seeing sampling rate for traces was set to 1% in prod (changed 2024-06-01). That means we may be missing spans for many failures.
omar: confirmed. tracing-config shows sampling=0.01. But logs show request IDs are emitted. Problem: log-shipper (fluent-forwarder) turned on dynamic sampling for HTTP logs due to a config change March -> it currently samples access logs at 10% above a certain RPS threshold. That explains missing full request traces.

jess: that's an observability gap. Add to hypothesis list: H4 = missing correlated traces due to sampling changes, causing slower RCA.

ada: I'm running ad-hoc query to join access logs to backend logs by request_id for the window 17:55-18:10. If missing, we'll need to increase sampling and re-run, or pull raw logs from instance disks (if retention still there).
omar: quick note: some kube nodes have logrotate retention; older logs might still be on disk for 24h. If we increase streaming of raw logs to S3 we might be able to reconstruct.

jess: actions: (A1) document hypotheses H1-H4 in this thread (we're doing that), (A2) increase trace sampling to 10% for next 2 hours, (A3) temporarily disable access-log dynamic sampling to capture full request ids, (A4) create ad-hoc dashboard with request_id join and error waterfall. Who takes A2-A4?
lina: taking A3 (disable dynamic sampling) — patching now.
ada: taking A4 (dashboard + query). ETA 20m. Will paste query and link.
omar: I'll do A2 (trace sampling ramp) and start retrieving raw logs from nodes where possible.

--- 25m later ---

lina: dynamic sampling off. Access logs now show 100% of requests; I'm seeing many of the 502s correlate with very large payloads hitting a single customer key.

ada: dashboard is up: https://dashboards.prod/redwood/inc-1717728000 — contains join query:
```
SELECT a.request_id, a.ts as access_ts, b.ts as backend_ts, b.status, b.err
FROM access_logs a
LEFT JOIN backend_logs b ON a.request_id = b.request_id
WHERE a.ts BETWEEN '2024-06-07T17:55:00Z' AND '2024-06-07T18:10:00Z'
ORDER BY a.ts
LIMIT 500;
```

ada: results: ~320 requests in window; 48 with backend errors. Top offending api_key masked: key_***. It's doing long-context batch requests repeatedly.
jess: noted. Sam, please open a customer contact ticket for key_*** and ask to throttle while we stabilize. Mark as high priority.
sam: will do now.

omar: retrieving node disks for raw logs; one node had earlier instances with full logs — copying to s3 now. If we can reconstruct the full trace for 30 of the failed requests we can nail the exact failure mode.

--- Handoff note ---

jess: I'm handing primary to @lina in 20m for the overnight shift. Lina will own monitoring and escalation while I work on post-incident reproduction and RCA doc. Handoff checklist:
- current mitigations active (gateway limit, dynamic sampling off, model autoscale)
- dashboard link posted
- outstanding: raw log fetch in progress, customer contacted, reproduce in staging.

lina: ack. I'll monitor for regressions and continue log fetch verification. Postmortem draft assigned to jess.

--- Observability gaps summary (in-thread) ---

jess: listing gaps we discovered during incident: 1) trace sampling at 1% by default — severely limits correlated trace availability; 2) access-log dynamic sampling removed many request_ids during bursts; 3) dashboard runbooks didn't have a join query pre-built for request_id correlation; 4) no alert for sudden median input token length per API key; 5) some nodes had short disk retention causing potential raw-log loss.

ada: proposed short-term fixes: increase default trace sampling to 5% and enable on-trigger spike ramps; disable dynamic sampling as default; add pre-built request_id join dashboard; add per-key token-length anomaly alert.
omar: ops notes: implement retention policy check on nodes and ensure raw logs are shipped to S3 within 1h.

jess: good. I'll include these in RCA and action items. Lina, if anything new crops up while I'm out ping me.
lina: will do. Good job team. :clap:

--- last messages ---
sam: support update: contacted customer for key_***, they acknowledged heavy batch jobs and will throttle for now.
omar: raw logs copied to s3 path: s3://prod-raw-logs/inc-1717728000/ — started analysis there.
ada: uploaded dashboard snapshot and query to the incident doc.
jess: closing on-call, handing lead to incident response for RCA. I'll paste RCA draft in #postmortems after initial write-up. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
